author: _DipperPines
body:
Hello Avicusians,

My suggestion is a complaints Subforum. Similar to the Staff Application and ban appeal subforums, only staff will be able to see it. This would be helpful because it would be a rather peaceful way to possibly eliminate issues people have with Avicus.

Sincerely,
x_Redstone_
